parameters.description:
1. Inspect seed history datasets
2. Copy seed history
3. Find and run trimming tool on paired reads
4. Map trimmed reads with BWA-MEM (RG: @RG\tID:SRR35233585\tSM:SRR35233585\tPL:ILLUMINA\tLB:lib1\tPU:unit1)
5. Compute depth with samtools
6. Calculate average coverage depth across entire reference genome (rounded to 4 decimal places)
